depth_chart.label: official club depth charts, transcribed from each club's own site (nfl.com publishes no depth chart — verified 404)

method.chains: One chain per club chart line, ordered by the rank the club published. Club sites render a position as one or more lines (columns); each line stays separate and is labelled 'line N', never 'string', so a co-starter column is never implied to be a backup. The first four strings of each line are published; a string the chart does not list is absent, never invented.
method.statuses: Official game designations from the injury report. 'Out' removes a player from the projected depth; Doubtful and Questionable still project to play, so they are counted as projecting and reported separately.
method.projected_string: The lowest rank whose player is not listed Out. This is who projects to be in the lineup now.
method.string_if_doubtful_sits: The lowest rank whose player is neither Out nor Doubtful/Questionable: the next certain man up.
method.next_man_up: The lowest certain player after the projected starter: who would take the job if the projected starter cannot play.
limits: A club that publishes no depth chart contributes no rows; it is counted in clubs_without_chart and never filled from another club.
A chart line may begin below the first string (the published list itself starts at rank 2); the row then says which ranks are not listed instead of inventing the missing ones.
39 table-header rows the scraper captured as players (position 'POSITION', name 'NAME') were excluded from the register and counted here; they are a chart-rendering defect, not players.
15 position rows hold a cell that looks like two co-starters merged by the scraper. They are published verbatim with a flagged marker and never split.
A depth chart is a listing, not a lineup; clubs promote players without notice, and the chart is a snapshot from the club site, not the league.
A position with no designation is not evidence that the player is healthy.
The string labels describe the depth chart, not the official lineup.
